archive_policy: Deterministic USTAR, sorted regular files, mode 0644, zero uid/gid/mtime, empty uname/gname; all code/data/config snapshots inert with final .txt suffix.

PROVENANCE.json: Records derivation and source evidence hashes without embedding source reports.
README.md: New product-facing summary of supported public APIs, arithmetic rules, preservation format, replay steps and explicit limits.
No source document was edited or represented as an exact copy.
SOURCE-MANIFEST.json: New inventory of exact inert snapshots, NEW test support, origin classes and pinned external dependencies.
TEST-RESULTS.json: Extracted bounded result facts, log hashes and exit status from prior verification evidence.
Added fresh isolated replay results and input identity; no broad pass inferred.

review_scope: Progression catalogs, deterministic offer materialization, read-only DTO projection and associated tests only.
reviewed_source_comments: Existing C1/R0 labels in exact code comments are test-tranche identifiers; no role assignment documents are included.
scope_exclusions: Raw source reports and execution logs
